title: Adopt Prefect 3 as GPWCF External Workflow Runtime
decision: Adopt Prefect 3.9.2 as the initial pinned external workflow runtime for GPWCF integration on Windows x64 / CPython 3.15.1. Prefect owns native workflow execution; GPWCF retains component contracts, composition semantics, identities, typed results, lifecycle and artifact obligations.
scope: This ADR confirms the selected target and authorizes target-specific integration qualification. It does not declare GPWCF implementation or full THIM conformance complete.

selectedBaseline.executionProfile: Native local execution using Prefect's local API/server profile

rationale: Python-native integration with the managed CPython runtime.
Existing reference-consumer fixture evidence supports Stage invocation, fan-out/fan-in, artifact handoff and conditional publication.
Native Prefect Flow/Subflow and Task constructs can realize the target hierarchy, subject to topology qualification.

positive: One concrete runtime target for the first integration.
Native Flow/Subflow/Task execution without a mandatory cross-language worker boundary.
constraints: Prefect Run IDs and State remain operational evidence, not GPWCF domain identities/results.
Exact local concurrency topology must be qualified.
Full dependency/license closure and clean environment reconstruction remain separate release requirements.

supersedes: The open candidate comparison for the primary workflow-runtime selection.
historicalEvidencePolicy: Do not rewrite or delete historical Prefect/Dagu candidate evidence; retain it as decision provenance.
